fusions.name: Headlong
fusions.desc: Gallops at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 13 blunt damage, rising to 1.6 times that at 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Thunder Underfoot
fusions.desc: Rears and stamps, dealing 28 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Full Stretch
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with 8% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Pounding Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
